hypothesis: At an exact 15m boundary, when the new candle OPEN itself is above the upper Bollinger band on multiple timeframes, price has a measurable short-side tendency to revisit an entry-frozen upper-band boundary before extending further upward.

signal_semantics.bollinger: 20-period, 2 std; for each TF use previous 19 completed TF closes plus current 15m-boundary OPEN
signal_semantics.upper_break_count: number of TFs where OPEN > entry-time upper BB
signal_semantics.fresh_definition: current count meets threshold but immediately prior 15m boundary did not

targets.NEAREST_BAND: highest upper-BB price among breached TFs; smallest required pullback
targets.MEDIAN_BAND: median upper-BB price among breached TFs
targets.DEEPEST_BAND: lowest upper-BB price among breached TFs; largest required pullback
targets.15M_BAND: 15M upper BB when 15M itself is breached

primary_diagnostics: target revisit rate regardless of stop by 15m/30m/1h/2h/4h
selection_rule: Do not promote a best configuration from this scan. Use it only to identify whether the phenomenon exists and which boundary/count family deserves a separately preregistered validation.
